hypothesis: When embedding an inner horizontal micro action dock inside a scroll container governed by touch-action: pan-y, WebKit gesture intersection suppresses horizontal pan unless inner container explicitly stops pointer propagation and declares touch-action: pan-x.

When onAddToItinerary is omitted, primary action bar falls back to full-width navigation CTA; if micro dock does not conditionally suppress the dock navigation button, duplicate navigation CTAs are rendered simultaneously.
Retaining ghost buttons for photos and Google Maps at the bottom of the drawer consumes 52px vertical height, causing edge cutoff and visual truncation on mobile half-detent viewports.
